text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Could you please tell me your age and describe the physical features or symptoms that concern you, particularly regarding your development and bone health?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text: You have primary amenorrhea, ambiguous genitalia at birth, and a history of fractures. REQUEST TEST: Karyotype, 17-hydroxyprogesterone, Testosterone, DHEAS, and Bone Density Scan.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those test results seem inconsistent with the clinical picture of ambiguous genitalia and primary amenorrhea. REQUEST TEST: Pelvic Ultrasound, 11-deoxycortisol, and Androstenedione levels.
